project.name: DRSQ Oasis LLC Website
project.description: A structured content, brand, sitemap, messaging, services, impact, team, careers, and technical-direction MCP based on the publicly available IQ Solutions website.

brand.name: DRSQ Oasis LLC
brand.positioning: A health-focused communications, technology, research, training, and technical-assistance organization that turns evidence-based information into clear, engaging, accessible experiences.
brand.mission: Make it easier for people to find, understand, and use information that leads to better health.
brand.vision: Deliver impactful solutions that promote quality of life by making evidence-based information clear, engaging, and useful for everyone.

writing_rules: Connect technology and research to human outcomes.
Lead with audience needs and measurable impact.
Support claims with concrete metrics when available.

website_build_direction.design_direction: Modern public-health / government-services aesthetic: clean layouts, accessible typography, strong whitespace, human photography, restrained professional color use, data-driven cards, and prominent impact metrics.

source_notes: Content was researched from publicly available DRSQ Oasis LLC pages on drks-allignment-llc.com.
Some figures and claims are presented as they appear on the source site and should be revalidated before publication.
This MCP is intended as a structured website/content specification, not a copy of the site's source code.
